topic: 弓状束三段式纤维架构与语言白质基础

sources.title: Perisylvian language networks of the human brain
sources.authors: Catani M, Jones DK, ffytche DH
sources.access_note: Wiley paywall; no PMC open access version found
sources.core_contribution: 首次DTI报告弓状束三段式结构（直接段/间接后段/间接前段），奠定现代AF解剖模型基础
used_for: 传导性失语的解剖基础

sources.title: The cortical organization of speech processing
sources.core_contribution: 语言双流模型（腹侧=意义，背侧=发音/句法），AF作为背侧流主干白质通路的理论框架
used_for: AF在背侧语言流中的位置

sources.title: DTI tractography of the human brain's language pathways
sources.core_contribution: 左侧AF终止于pSTG（语音皮层）vs 右侧AF终止于MTG（韵律皮层）；解释AF左侧化的具体解剖机制
used_for: 左右AF的功能差异化靶区描述

sources.title: Language development and the ontogeny of the dorsal pathway
sources.core_contribution: Dorsal Pathway I（出生即有，颞叶→前运动区）vs Dorsal Pathway II（7岁前未成熟，颞叶→BA44）；句法关键期的白质基础
used_for: 句法关键期的神经基础

sources.title: Dorsal and ventral pathways in language development
sources.authors: Brauer J, Anwander A, Perani D, Friederici AD
sources.core_contribution: 腹侧路径成熟先于背侧路径额叶端；新生儿-7岁-成人发育对比研究
used_for: 腹侧/背侧路径发育时序对比

sources.title: Anatomical predictors of aphasia recovery: a tractography study of bilateral perisylvian language networks
sources.authors: Forkel SJ, Thiebaut de Schotten M, Dell'Acqua F, Kalra L, Murphy DGM, Williams SCR, Catani M
sources.core_contribution: 右半球AF长直接段体积预测左脑卒中后失语恢复（预测准确率28%→57%）；右半球语言代偿的解剖基础
used_for: 双侧语言网络的临床意义

sources.title: Primate auditory prototype in the evolution of the arcuate fasciculus
sources.authors: Balezeau F, Wilson B, Gallardo G, Dick F, Hopkins W, Anwander A, Friederici AD, Griffiths TD, Petkov CI
sources.core_contribution: 跨物种比较：猕猴/黑猩猩/人类都有AF听觉原型，但人类独有高度左侧化；AF演化是对祖先通路的定向改写而非从头发明
used_for: 人类AF左侧化的跨物种证据

sources.title: Controversy over the temporal cortical terminations of the left arcuate fasciculus: a reappraisal
sources.core_contribution: AF颞叶端可能延伸至MTG、ITG/梭状回（VWFA）、基底颞叶语言区，超越传统Wernicke区范围

sources.title: A narrative review of the anatomy and function of the white matter tracts in language production and comprehension
sources.core_contribution: AF负责音韵（非语义）功能；AF损伤→语音性错语（vs IFOF损伤→语义性错语）；8条语言白质通路的综合综述
used_for: AF音韵功能的直接行为证据

sources.title: Exploring the arcuate fasciculus from a clinical perspective
sources.authors: Shao ZD, Gong YJ, Ren J, Wang J
sources.core_contribution: AF三段式临床综述；不同脑部疾病（脑卒中/肿瘤/精神疾病）对AF的影响；DTI量化分析工具
used_for: 三段式结构的临床重要性

coverage_assessment.limitation_note: Catani 2005（三段式模型的发现论文）和Glasser 2008（左右AF差异化靶区）均为摘要仅读。Catani 2005是关键原始来源，其核心发现（三段式结构）已被大量后续研究复现，使用是合理的。Giampiccolo 2022（颞叶端争议）也是摘要仅读，但文章中已明确标注其结论为有争议的新兴证据。
